# v2.1.0b4

## 2026-11-08

This beta improves entity controls on the native C300X display while keeping
the original blue design. It includes the features and fixes from the previous
2.1.0 betas. The stable release remains **2.0.0**.

## Native Display

- Lights gain eight color swatches, warm/neutral/cool white presets within the
  device's supported Kelvin range, and a larger brightness reading. Selecting
  a color sends hue and saturation together in one command.
- Covers show reported position visually and distinguish opening from closing.
  Supported up/stop/down buttons stay visible while scrolling; position and
  tilt remain separate controls. Unknown position is never shown as closed.
- Climate entities distinguish actual heating/cooling activity from the selected
  HVAC mode. Supported fan and vertical/horizontal swing modes are available
  alongside temperature ranges and presets.
- Fans gain capability-based speed, oscillation, presets and direction controls.
  On/off commands respect the entity's current state and supported features.
- Sensors and binary sensors have larger overview readings and read-only detail
  views. Numeric sensors retain their unit and reported precision; selected
  battery, humidity and illuminance attributes appear when available.

Controls use confirmed HA state and the existing event bridge. No additional
polling, refresh timers, history queries or device-file writes are introduced
by these views. HA revalidates each command against the selected entity and
its current capabilities.

## Update

1. In HACS, open the integration menu, choose **Redownload**, enable beta
   versions and select **2.1.0b4**.
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Complete the agent-update Repair to install the rebuilt **2.1.0b4** agent.
4. Reapply the **Display patch** for the new native views, including when
   upgrading from an earlier beta. Applying it restarts the device GUI.

Local tests include simulated rendering in four languages and command
interactions. These do not replace testing on the actual C300X display;
physical rendering and Ring Call interruption remain beta checks.

See [beta and update guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b4/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#beta-versions)
and [display controls](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b4/docs/feature-reference.md#display-device-controls).
